# Example: Multiple Selectors

#### Course: CSS Fundamentals for Your First Webpage

## Example: Multiple Selectors

Consider this example:

```html
1<h1>Grocery items</h1>
2<p>I really need to buy these items.</p>
3<p>Here's the list:</p>
4<ul>
5    <li>milk</li>
6    <li>bread</li>
7    <li>sugar</li>
8</ul>
```

```css
1h1, p {
2    color: blue;
3}
```

This webpage (HTML part) contains a heading, two paragraphs, and a list. Now, click on the style.css tab to view the CSS code.

In this code, the selectors target two tags, <h1> and <p>, separated by a comma. If you run the code, you'll see that the text of the heading (h1) and both paragraphs are blue.

However, the list's text color remains unchanged, as we haven't written any code to target it.
